👩‍🎨 About the Artist

Colours are my Superpower!

Ruby Bharat Singh is a passionate multidisciplinary visual artist who transforms blank canvases into living, breathing stories. With deep roots in Indian classical art and a love for modern techniques, Ruby bridges tradition and creativity beautifully!

From hyper-realistic watercolour portraits to bold abstract acrylics and intricate miniature paintings — each piece has its own unique soul, emotion, and magic. ✨

🎨 Watercolour 🖌️ Indian Classical 🌀 Acrylic Abstract ✏️ Pencil Sketch 🖼️ Portraiture
🏛️ Behind the Canvas

Artist in Action!

Every Stroke is Magic! ✨

In Ruby's studio, art is not just made — it is felt deeply. Each painting begins as an emotion and ends as a conversation between the artist and viewer.

Working across multiple mediums with the same dedication — from the gentlest pencil sketch to large-scale classical paintings. 🎨
